ARABIC — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

2. When practising Guided Reading : Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.

----
